decisions: Restructured CLAUDE.md: Session Protocol + Oversight Policy + Hooks at top (primacy), Critical Reminders at bottom (recency). Trigger table and workspace layout moved to middle.
Renamed 'Subagent Guidance' to 'Subagent Policy' in all 3 flow skills — now explicitly enforces single-writer model (main agent writes, subagents read-only)
State snapshot now filters out pending tasks — only includes in_progress and blocked. Pending tasks remain in tasks.jsonl but don't consume context.
Added session-knowledge.json as a handoff API between sessions — decisions, key_locations, dead_ends, open_questions

key_locations.context_gate_sections: All 3 flow skills under '## Context Gate'

open_questions: Should context gate be enforced by a hook (deterministic) rather than just skill guidance (prompt-based)?
Should MEMORY.md support scope tags to filter irrelevant memories at session start?
tf-030 (context metrics in run records) would close the measurement loop — not implemented yet
